Utilizes micro-bubble cavitation collapse shockwaves to unfold globular proteins, exposing cleavage sites and slashing enzymatic reaction cycles from 4 hours down to 25 minutes while cutting enzyme requirements by 45%.

Generates intense micro-cavitation clouds without high-speed moving parts, facilitating simultaneous lignocellulose loosening and enzymatic fiber solubilization.

Stage 1 physically opens compact quaternary globulin folds; Stage 2 micro-mixes endo/exopeptidases under mild cavitation to eliminate bitter hydrophobic peptide terminal groups.

targetMatrices.name: Yellow Pea Protein Isolate (Legumin & Vicilin 7S/11S Globulins)
targetMatrices.bitternessTendency: Moderate (Hydrophobic core residues Phe, Leu, Ile exposed)
targetMatrices.description: Compact globular pulse protein characterized by tight hydrophobic cores that resist digestive and industrial enzymes. Hydrodynamic cavitation unfolds the 11S legumin hexamers, boosting solubility across pH 4–7 from 34% to over 95% and eliminating beany vegetal off-notes.

targetMatrices.name: Defatted Soy Protein Flakes (Glycinin 11S & β-Conglycinin 7S)
targetMatrices.bitternessTendency: High if uncontrolled (Rich in bitter hydrophobic peptide fragments)
targetMatrices.description: Major commercial plant protein source containing prominent food allergens (Gly m 5, Gly m 6). Cavitation-assisted hydrolysis cleaves immunogenic conformational epitopes, achieving a 94% reduction in antigenicity while delivering clean-tasting, non-bitter peptide hydrolysates.

targetMatrices.name: Spent Brewer's Grain & Dietary Fiber Slurry (Lignocellulose & Insoluble Hordein)
targetMatrices.description: Dense brewery coproduct rich in insoluble cellulose, arabinoxylans, and trapped protein. Micro-cavitation shear tears open recalcitrant lignocellulosic matrices, enabling rapid multi-enzyme degradation into soluble prebiotic oligosaccharides and low-molecular-weight peptides.

targetMatrices.name: Barista Oat Insoluble Protein & β-Glucan Sediment Slurry
targetMatrices.bitternessTendency: Very Low (Natural oat oatrim sweetness preserved)
targetMatrices.description: Oat milling byproduct containing chalky insoluble globulins and complex starches that destabilize coffee microfoam. Cavitation-assisted biocatalysis solubilizes over 96% of residual solids, preventing steam wand sedimentation and curdle breakdown in hot espresso.

targetMatrices.name: Bovine Milk Protein Concentrate (MPC-85 & Cross-Linked Whey)
targetMatrices.description: Thermal-damaged dairy concentrates prone to insolubility and gelation during ambient storage. Cavitation shear gently dissociates cross-linked micellar aggregates, facilitating selective cleavage into hypoallergenic infant-grade bioactive peptides with superior heat stability.

cavitationGenerators.name: High-Speed Radial Perforated Rotor-Stator Cavitation Cylinder (ShockWave Power Reactor)
cavitationGenerators.description: Cylindrical rotor with machined micro-cavitation wells spinning within an electropolished stator. Generates millions of microscopic vacuum cavities per second; their violent collapse creates intense localized shear waves that untangle globular protein chains without bulk thermal rise.

cavitationGenerators.name: Hydrodynamic Multi-Hole Venturi Orifice Cavitation Plate
cavitationGenerators.description: Engineered multi-aperture restriction plate. Fluid acceleration through converging-diverging nozzles produces hydrodynamic cavitation clouds in the wake zone, offering durable continuous operation for abrasive plant fibers with zero mechanical rotating wear.

cavitationGenerators.name: Counter-Rotating Dual-Rotor High-Shear Cavitation Reactor
cavitationGenerators.description: Opposing dual-disk geometry generating extreme differential velocities (>65 m/s) and sub-0.10 cavitation numbers. Maximizes the rate of enzyme-substrate collisions, ideal for ultra-compact processing loops with sub-15 minute residence times.

cavitationGenerators.name: Conventional Low-Shear Impeller Agitated Tank (Hazardous / Ineffective Control)
cavitationGenerators.description: Traditional batch stirred tank lacking cavitation dynamics (cavitation number σ >> 1.0). Protein globules remain tightly folded; enzymes suffer diffusion limitations and thermal inactivation over prolonged 4–8 hour incubation, producing bitter hydrolysates and low yields.

enzymeFormulations.name: Alcalase 2.4L FG (Bacillus licheniformis Subtilisin A Endoprotease)
enzymeFormulations.cleavageSpecificity: Hydrophobic amino acid residues (Phe, Tyr, Trp, Leu, Val)
enzymeFormulations.thermalStabilityMargin: High (Thermal buffer ΔT > 10°C under continuous cooling)
enzymeFormulations.description: Industry-standard alkaline microbial endoprotease. Exceptionally active in cleaving internal peptide bonds of globular plant proteins. Under hydrodynamic cavitation, its catalytic velocity V_max increases by 320% due to instantaneous substrate bond presentation.

enzymeFormulations.name: Flavourzyme 1000L (Aspergillus oryzae Endo- and Exopeptidase Complex)
enzymeFormulations.cleavageSpecificity: Terminal amino acids & bitter hydrophobic oligopeptide ends
enzymeFormulations.thermalStabilityMargin: Moderate (Requires strict loop temperature control T < 52°C)
enzymeFormulations.description: Proprietary fungal fungal enzyme blend containing both endoproteases and aminopeptidases. Specifically engineered to hydroyze terminal bitter hydrophobic residues, producing smooth, neutral-tasting protein hydrolysates with debittering efficiency >98%.

enzymeFormulations.name: Food-Grade Plant Protease Cocktail (Carica papaya Papain & Ananas comosus Bromelain)
enzymeFormulations.cleavageSpecificity: Broad specificity across basic and aromatic peptide bonds
enzymeFormulations.thermalStabilityMargin: Superior (Robust plant enzymes tolerant to high shear)
enzymeFormulations.description: Natural non-GMO enzyme complex favored for clean-label plant-based beverages and infant nutrition. Exhibits broad cleavage activity and high resilience to cavitation shockwaves, producing gentle, digestible peptide profiles.

enzymeFormulations.name: Thermally Denatured Incompatible Hydrolase (Hazardous / Ineffective Control)
enzymeFormulations.description: Improperly selected or thermally compromised enzyme preparation. Fails to cleave unfolded polypeptide chains, resulting in reaction stalling, heavy bitter peptide buildup, and severe microbial contamination risk during extended holding.
